extra.motion: The camera does not move. The small grey delivery robot stays exactly where it is, parked outside on the threshold of the open blast doors; it does not move forward at all. It gives one small settle on its wheels and its amber beacon pulses bright and slow. Outside, the grass on the downs ripples in a light breeze. In the foreground the old woman, seen from behind, stays still; only her shoulders stiffen slightly. Nothing blows inside the corridor. The camera does not move.

The small grey delivery robot drives steadily and clearly down the slope straight towards the camera, growing larger in the frame second by second until it passes close by the lower edge of the frame, following its own two wheel tracks, which stay pressed into the grass behind it all the way back to the bunker.
